scene.title: Building a BST by inserting values
scene.summary: Step‑by‑step insertion of 15, 10, 20, 8, and 12 into a binary search tree.

beats.title: Start with empty tree
beats.narration: We begin with an empty binary search tree.

beats.title: Insert 15 as root
beats.narration: 15 becomes the root because the tree is empty.

beats.title: Insert 10 left of 15
beats.narration: 10 is less than 15, so it becomes the left child.

beats.title: Insert 20 right of 15
beats.narration: 20 is greater than 15, so it becomes the right child.

beats.title: Insert 8 under 10
beats.narration: 8 < 15, go left; 8 < 10, go left again, becoming left child of 10.

beats.title: Insert 12 under 10
beats.narration: 12 < 15, go left; 12 > 10, go right, becoming right child of 10.
